eps_fy: 082-083 (full year, unaudited, basic EPS as printed in SBL's own Q4 FY2082/83 report, Bank standalone column)
eps_calc_note: EPS = (profit for the period 3,519,409,797 - preference dividend 107,589,041) / WANOS 147,944,792 = 23.0614 -> 23.06. WANOS is the year-end ordinary share count with the 7,044,990 bonus shares restated retroactively per NAS 33; confirmed because the prior-year comparative EPS of 22.76 only reconciles on the post-bonus count (3,366,594,282/147,944,792=22.76; pre-bonus would give 23.89). Preference dividend is the actual part-year amount printed in the Statement of Distributable Profit, NOT the full-year 8.25% x 3.5bn = 288,750,000 (PNCPS outstanding ~136 days).
eps_alt_note: All three published EPS use the same denominator 147,944,792 and differ only in preference-dividend treatment: 23.06 bank (actual part-year pref div), 21.84 sharesansar (over-deducts full-year 288,750,000), 23.79 merolagani (no pref deduction). Use 23.06.
pe_fy_end_note: SBL's own reported P/E in the Q4 FY2082/83 'Major Financial Indicators' box: 395 / 23.06 = 17.13. Rs 395 is the FY-close price (FY high 414.60, low 368.00, 64 traded days in Q4).
book_value_source: Net Worth Per Share as printed in SBL Q4 FY2082/83 report (excludes PNCPS). Merolagani shows 225.90.

financial_history.source: PRIMARY: SBL 'Unaudited Financial Results (4th Quarter of Fiscal Year 2082/83)' published statement, Bank standalone column. Local copy: scratchpad/SiddharthaBank_Reports/SBL_Quarterly_Q4_2025-26.pdf
financial_history.note: All figures read directly off the published Q4 statement and arithmetically verified. EPS 23.06 = (3,519,409,797 - 107,589,041) / 147,944,792. Bank's reported P/E 17.13 = 395 / 23.06. WANOS confirmed as the post-bonus year-end count via the prior-year comparative EPS 22.76. CORRECTION vs earlier entries: 3,233,947,946 is Total Comprehensive Income (net profit + OCI of -285,461,851), NOT net profit attributable to ordinary holders -- it must never be used as an EPS numerator. Preference dividend is the actual part-year 107,589,041, not the full-year 288,750,000.

financial_history.source: SBL Q4 FY2082/83 published statement, 'Previous Year Corresponding / Immediate Previous Year Ending (Audited)' Bank columns
financial_history.note: EPS 22.76 is RESTATED on the post-bonus share count 147,944,792 (3,366,594,282/147,944,792=22.76) per NAS 33; on the then-outstanding 140,899,802 shares it was 23.89. No preference shares existed this year. Use the restated 22.76 for YoY comparison against FY082/83's 23.06 -- comparing 23.06 against an unrestated 23.89 would falsely show a decline.
